title: Crash when using Animation Tree on Wayland
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: Godot Engine v4.7.2.stable.official (ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079) ### System information Godot v4.7.2.stable - Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (nvidia; 580.173.02) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600K (20 threads) - 31.10 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description When using a AnimationTree Node with AnimationNodeStateMachine it will crash when trying to add animations from the AnimationPlayer. It does not happen every time you add an Animation but after a few tries it crashes. Crash Logs: [crash_logs.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31805400/crash_logs.txt) Most relevant: ``` ERROR: Wayland client error code 24. at: _wl_display_check_error (platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp:212) ERROR: /root: The caller thread can't call the function `propagate_notification()` on this node. Use `call_deferred()` or `call_deferred_thread_group()` instead. at: propagate_notification (scene/main/node.cpp:2578) ================================================================ handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 4 Engine version: Godot Engine v4.7.2.stable.official (ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079) Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug on: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues Load address: 72c7a3000000 ERROR: Cannot create pipe from command: "/home/cain/.cargo/bin/addr2line" "--version" 2>/dev/null. at: execute (drivers/unix/os_unix.cpp:899) ERROR: Cannot create pipe from command: "llvm-addr2line" "--version" 2>/dev/null. at: execute (drivers/unix/os_unix.cpp:899) ERROR: Cannot create pipe from command: "addr2line" "0x4f99fe" "0x72c7a3045330" "0x4e5a7b" "0x4e5c20" "0x4406195" "0x52e6c23" "0x72c7a309cb84" "0x72c7a3129d6c" "-e" "/opt/godot/godot.x86_64" "-f" "-p" "-C" 2>/dev/null. at: execute (drivers/unix/os_unix.cpp:899) [1] 72c7a3045330 (main+45330) - /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(+0x45330) [0x72c7a3045330] [2] 4e5a7b (godot.x86_64+e5a7b) - /opt/godot/godot.x86_64() [0x4e5a7b] [3] 4e5c20 (godot.x86_64+e5c20) - /opt/godot/godot.x86_64() [0x4e5c20] [4] 4406195 (godot.x86_64+4006195) - /opt/godot/godot.x86_64() [0x4406195] [5] 52e6c23 (godot.x86_64+4ee6c23) - /opt/godot/godot.x86_64() [0x52e6c23] [6] 72c7a309cb84 (main+9cb84) - /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(+0x9cb84) [0x72c7a309cb84] [7] 72c7a3129d6c (main+129d6c) - /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6(+0x129d6c) [0x72c7a3129d6c] -- END OF C++ BACKTRACE -- ================================================================ ``` Happening when adding animations (Right click dialog not visible): ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a Scene with an Animation Player and an Animation Tree 2. Create some Animation in the Animation Player 3. Add Animations to the AnimationTree 4. Do it until it crashes (Usually takes a few tries but it is reproducible) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
